summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, solely to announce its participation at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference scheduled for September 14-16 in New York, where executives will host a fireside chat and one-on-one meetings. No transaction, strategic event, or material corporate action is described. The filing is a routine conference participation notice common among listed biopharmaceutical companies. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or structural considerations. The event is purely informational with a webcast available. As a result, this is not a special-situation filing and warrants no further analysis.
